notes.title: Our game is going free!
notes.content:
As our studio has shut down, we've chosen to make the game free to ensure it lives on. Starting September 30, the price will be updated to zero.

For those of you who have already purchased the game, nothing changes. You’ll still have full access to the experience you’ve come to enjoy. Thank you for the trust and support you’ve shown us.
